policy: all measurement runs on dedicated idle A100 GPUs (GPU 4 room chain, GPU 5 bicycle chain where parallel; identity verified before any run; no foreign compute on the measurement GPU during timing; paired-run contamination policy inherited from P12)

freeze_semantics.mechanism: row-masked Adam (gather active rows, update, scatter back); frozen rows never read-written
freeze_semantics.per_step_bitwise_guard: torch.equal on frozen rows of params/exp_avg/exp_avg_sq every step
